parameters.query: SELECT PatentQueryNr as query_id, PatentQueryQuery as query, PatentQueryLastRun as last_run, PatentQueryTitel as title FROM if_patent_query WHERE PatentQueryAktiv = 'j' AND (TO_DAYS(PatentQueryLastRun) < TO_DAYS(NOW()) OR PatentQueryLastRun IS NULL) LIMIT 1
UPDATE if_patent_query SET PatentQueryLastRun = NOW() WHERE PatentQueryNr = {{ $('MYSQL: Queries').item.json.query_id }}

SELECT *, YEAR(A.PatentResultPublishedDate) AS PatentResultJahr
FROM   if_patent_results AS A
LEFT JOIN if_patent_query as B ON A.PatentQueryNr=B.PatentQueryNr
WHERE  PatentResultUebernommen = 'j'
ORDER BY PatentResultNr ASC
LIMIT 50
